title: I made a roguelike card game with hand-drawn art + AI coloring
author: xRizDev
selftext:
​

Hey guys!!

So, about a month ago I released my little game SuperHero Crawler, completely free on Android (so… healthy spam! 😂).

It's a roguelike card game, kinda Slay the Spire mixed with Vampire Survivors, with a bunch of my own ideas… and a cat that basically causes all the problems. 🐱

The reason I'm posting it here is mainly because of the art workflow.

Everything is sketched and drawn by hand in Illustrator, together with a friend. We then use AI for the coloring, while the actual characters, designs, compositions and assets are made by us.

There are now 200+ cards, 22 heroes, 70+ animations, relics, events, passives and 3 game modes (Campaign, Daily & Endless).

I'm definitely not an artist, so I'd love to hear what you guys think about the result and especially the AI-assisted coloring workflow.

If anyone wants to give it a try, I'll be really happy! ❤️

[PlayStore](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.herobuilder.agenciadehroes)

 The trailer is… let's just say video editing isn't exactly my superpower 😂

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: Great use of AI. Love seeing artists that actually embrace it in their workflow while keeping their vision intact.

replies.author: xRizDev
replies.body: Thank you so much! Honestly, I wouldn't call myself a traditional artist more of an indie dev trying to bring a vision to life so hearing this really means a lot. Keeping consistency was definitely the main goal with this workflow
